<div style="margin:0 5px">Lootbugs spawn on the main screen every 20 game minutes. When you tap on them, you can claim a free reward. You can also pay {{Gems|}} to get an additional reward. ==Lootbug Upgrades==
You can improve Lootbugs by increasing their stats:
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootbug_Spawn_Rate_Multiplier|Lootbug Spawn Rate Multiplier]] - Increases the rate at which lootbugs can show up
* [[Stats#tabber-Triple_Lootbug_Chance|Triple Lootbug Chance]] - Increases the chance to spawn 3 lootbugs at the same time instead of 1 (does nothing past 100%)
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Lootbug_Chance|Golden Lootbug Chance]] - Increases the chance to spawn a Golden lootbug instead of regular one (provides free gem buff)
* [[Stats#tabber-Banked_Lootbug_Cap|Banked Lootbug Cap]] - Increases the maximum amount of stored lootbugs 
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootbug_Gem_Cost_Reduction|Gem Cost Reduction]] - Decreases the amount of gems needed to buy buffs
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootbug_Loot_Multiplier|Lootbug Loot Multiplier]] - Increases the buffs and rewards multiplier obtained from lootbugs
* [[Stats#tabber-Lanterns_Used|Lanterns Used]] - Tracks amount of [[Items#LootbugLantern|Lootbug Lantern]] eaten. They increase lootbug cap up to +25

==Golden Lootbugs==
Golden lootbugs grant the Gem buff for free, without a need of spending gems. They can be unlocked via [[File:Aquarius.png|16px]] [[Stargazing#Aquarius|Aquarius star]] upgrades or certain [[File:Lootbugbonanza vp.png|16px]] [[Store#Value_Packs|Store bundles]].

==Buffs==
Lootbug buffs are chosen randomly with weights. A reward with a weight of 30 will appear twice as often as a reward with a weight of 15. Some buffs are locked until certain content is unlocked. The base values in these tables are then multiplied by your [[Stats#tabber-Lootbug_Loot_Multiplier|Lootbug Loot Multiplier]].

Lootbug skins are obtained during [[Events]] after reaching wave 40 and claiming the reward. They are automatically equipped and are selected randomly when Lootbug spawns.
